summary: This note is the reference list (pp. 249–285) for a chapter in Sensory Linguistics: Language, perception and metaphor by Bodo Winter, volume 20 of the John Benjamins series Converging Evidence in Language and Communication Research (2019). It lists scholarly works, mostly alphabetized from Abraham onward, on synesthesia, sensory metaphor, multisensory perception, embodied cognition, taste and smell language, and statistical tools. The text is cut off partway through the B entries, at Birch, J.
one_line: Partial reference list from Bodo Winter's 2019 chapter in Sensory Linguistics on sensory metaphor, multisensory perception and embodied language.
key_facts: The reference list spans pages 249 to 285 of the 2019 book Sensory Linguistics: Language, perception and metaphor, listed under Bodo Winter.
The book is part of the series Converging Evidence in Language and Communication Research, volume 20, published by John Benjamins.
The first entry is Abraham, W. (1987), 'Synästhesie als Metapher', Folia Linguistica 21, pp. 155–190.
Akpinar and Berger (2015), 'Drivers of cultural success: The case of sensory metaphors', appeared in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, volume 109, pp. 20–34.
Alais and Burr (2004), 'The ventriloquist effect results from near-optimal bimodal integration', appeared in Current Biology 14, pp. 257–262.
Barsalou, L. W. (1999), 'Perceptual symbol systems', appeared in Behavioral and Brain Sciences 22, pp. 577–660.
Barsalou, L. W. (2008), 'Grounded cognition', appeared in Annual Review of Psychology 59, pp. 617–645.
Bergen, B. K. (2012), 'Louder than words: The new science of how the mind makes meaning', published by Basic Books in New York.
Berlin and Kay (1969), 'Basic color terms: Their universality and evolution', published by the University of California Press in Berkeley.
Birch, J. (2012), 'Worldwide prevalence of red-green color deficiency', appeared in the Journal of the Optical Society of America A, volume 29, pp. 313–320.
Bates, Maechler, Bolker and Walker (2015b), 'Fitting Linear Mixed-Effects Models using lme4', appeared in the Journal of Statistical Software 67, pp. 1–48.
Baccianella, Esuli and Sebastiani (2010), 'SentiWordNet 3.0', was presented at the 7th Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation, pp. 2200–2204.
Bagli, M. (2016), 'Shakespeare's use of taste words', appeared in the Journal of Literary Semantics 45, pp. 141–159.
Allan and Burridge (2006), 'Forbidden words: Taboo and the censoring of language', was published by Cambridge University Press.
The Ahlner and Zlatev (2010) entry is titled 'Cross-modal iconicity: A cognitive semiotic approach to sound symbolism' and appeared in Sign Systems Studies 1, pp. 298–348.
The list is truncated mid-entry at Birch, J., so later references are not included in this note.
